newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: South African IT firm Softline lists on JSE.
newsitem.headline: South African IT firm Softline lists on JSE.

text.p: Information technology concern Softline Ltd is to list on the Johannesburg Stock Exchange on Wednesday and the company predicted growth in both earnings and dividend over the coming year.
It also announced it was engaged in negotiations which could have an effect on its share price.

Softline forecast earnings per share rising from a proforma 4.0 cents in the year to Feruary 28, 1997, to 6.0 cents in the year to February 28, 1998, while the dividend was forecast to increase from 1.3 to 2.0 cents.
Attributable income was forecast at 6.66 million rand in 1996/97 and 10.02 million in 1997/98.
